data.narrative:
General Galactic operates in the Climate & Energy sector at the Seed stage, having raised $10M to date. The comp universe consists of 9 private peers in the same sector—including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen—alongside 1 public comparable (LNZA). However, the peer set lacks sufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage matches to support a reliable median-based valuation, limiting methodological breadth.

Stage-progression analysis, the primary applicable method, treats total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage transitions. This yields an implied valuation of $25M. A sensitivity band around this result—accounting for variance in multiplier application—generates a low-end estimate of $21M and a high-end estimate of $29M.

The triangulated range of $21M–$29M (median $25M) reflects a single method and should be interpreted accordingly. Key uncertainties include the absence of narrowly-filtered peers at the same stage, which prevents validation through relative valuation, and the inherent volatility of early-stage multipliers in frontier-tech subsectors. Further precision would require either identification of additional same-stage Climate & Energy Seed companies or direct performance metrics (revenue, unit economics, or IP defensibility assessments) not present in the current dataset.
